en.seoDescription: Choir practice tracks and SATB learning tracks for voice-part rehearsal on your own WordPress site. Listen on a phone. Lite is free. Pro is €49 a year.
en.whatIs: Choir Rehearsal is a choir rehearsal app for WordPress. It holds choir practice tracks for voice parts rehearsal on the choir’s own site: SATB learning tracks for soprano, alto, tenor, and bass, next to the PDF score. Singer listens on a phone. Voice Leader adds the songs. Lite is free. Pro is €49 a year.
en.imageAlt: Choir Rehearsal, a rehearsal library for choirs

faq.a: Lite is free on WordPress.org. Pro is €49 per year for one choir website. A done-for-you setup starts at €120 and includes the first year of Pro.
Yes. Singer opens the choir site in the phone browser, signs in, and listens. There is no separate app to install.

faq.q: How does a singer get access?
faq.a: An Administrator creates a WordPress user and assigns the Singer role. The name of that role stays English. The singer then opens /rehearsal/ on the choir site and signs in. Guest can open songs marked public, without an account.

This website is in English, Estonian, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Swedish, and Finnish. In WordPress the plugin menus stay English: Choir Rehearsal, Pro License, Settings, and Add Song. The role names Singer, Voice Leader, Administrator, and Guest stay English. WordPress itself can use your language.

Songs, recordings, and scores stay on the choir’s own WordPress site. Compath OÜ does not host that library. The demo at demo.rehearsal.compath.ee is shared. Compath OÜ is at Ahtri 12, Tallinn, and answers at order@compath.ee or +372 55520482.

Veebileht on inglise, eesti, vene, saksa, prantsuse, itaalia, hispaania, rootsi ja soome keeles. WordPressis jäävad plugina menüüd inglise keelde: Choir Rehearsal, Pro License, Settings ja Add Song.
